name: ThatsMyAI

sources.title: Homepage — curated AI tools directory with categories, use cases, and Submit Tool nav
Submit page — full plan table and form fields: Free (≤90-day queue), Premium $49.99 (≤7 days), Priority $99.99 (immediate approval)

conditions: Free plan exists but carries up to a 90-day waiting period, standard search placement, max 3 tags, and no social promotion; paid tiers ($49.99/$99.99) jump to ≤7-day or immediate review
requirements: AI tools only — directory of AI apps across ~10 categories (chatbots, image, video, audio, code, productivity, agents, SEO/marketing, data, other)
Form fields: Tool Name, Website URL, Short Description, Category, Primary Use Case, Listing Plan, Tool Pricing Model, Contact Email, Logo (200x200px min, PNG/JPG, ≤2MB)
'Manually Reviewed / Quality-First / No Spam Tools' — low-quality submissions are rejected
No account wall visible — the form is self-serve with email notification
preparation: Logo file at least 200×200px, PNG or JPG, under 2MB
Tool name, canonical URL, short description (concise value prop)
Category + primary use case picks, and the tool's pricing model
Decide tier: Free ($0, ≤90d), Premium ($49.99, ≤7d), Priority ($99.99, immediate)
workflow: Fill Basic Information (name, URL, short description), Classification (category, use case), Visibility & Pricing (plan + tool pricing model), Contact Email, upload logo
Submit Your Tool — notification goes to the contact email when reviewed
Free listings wait up to 90 days; Priority gets immediate approval with dedicated support
watchFor: The free tier's 90-day queue is the real cost — plan accordingly
Claims of '1M+ monthly impressions / 100K+ active users' are unverified marketing
Premium/Priority are one-time payments per the plan table (verify at checkout)
Promoted listings are acknowledged in the FAQ — paid placement influences visibility, though marked as promotional
Homepage marketing claims 'we find, test, review' daily — but FAQ says they don't guarantee performance
countsAsLive: The tool appears on a thatsmy.ai listing page under its category/use-case after manual review
unknowns: Whether the free-tier backlink is dofollow (advertised as 'permanent SEO backlink')
Actual free-queue wait vs the 90-day maximum
